title: Dipole field expression
description: Essential: Correctly states the electric field along the dipole axis as E_p = 2p/(4*pi*epsilon_0*r^3) or equivalent simplified form.

title: Force on ion
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the force as f = -alpha*Q^2/(8*pi^2*epsilon_0^2*r^5) in the radial direction.

title: Potential energy derivation
description: Important: Correctly integrates the force from infinity to r to obtain U = -alpha*Q^2/(32*pi^2*epsilon_0^2*r^4).

title: Conservation laws application
description: Important: Applies both angular momentum conservation (v_max = v_0*b/r_min) and energy conservation to set up the equation for r_min.

title: Closest approach distance
description: Essential: Correctly solves the conservation equation to find r_min = (b/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(1 + sqrt(1 - K/b^4)), with K = alpha*Q^2/(4*pi^2*epsilon_0^2*m*v_0^2).

title: Critical parameter condition
description: Important: Identifies the condition for spiral motion as the discriminant becoming negative (1 - K/b^4 < 0).

title: Cross-sectional area
description: Essential: Correctly states the charge exchange cross section as A = pi * sqrt(alpha*Q^2/(4*pi^2*epsilon_0^2*m*v_0^2)).

title: Induced dipole moment
description: Important: Correctly relates the induced dipole moment to the ion's field: p = alpha*E_ion = -alpha*Q/(4*pi*epsilon_0*r^2).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign or direction for the force, potential energy, or field vectors (e.g., missing negative sign for attractive interaction).

title: Algebraic or exponent mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes errors in algebraic manipulation, binomial expansion, or exponent handling (e.g., wrong power of r in force or energy).
